text:
Alex Chen: seeing a flurry of failures from bakery when publishing latest infra-builder image, looks like credential cache expired on a subset of nodes :confused:
Maria Gomez: can you paste the error? CI shows the push failing but unclear why
Alex Chen: root log -> 
```
# docker push registry.redwood-infra/internal/builder:2026-03-18
DENIED: Token has expired for repo: internal/builder
cosign: verification failed: no matching signature found
SBOM generation: error writing sbom.json: permission denied
```
Jonatan Patel: hmm token expiry + cosign + sbom permissions... two separate failure modes triggered in the same run, likely the bakery credential cache (gcloud/oidc) is stale on some build agents
Tia Nguyen: @Jonatan can we force a cache refresh? we don't want to unblock by disabling cosign verification unless necessary :eyes: 
Jonatan Patel: yes, plan: rotate short-lived tokens on the bakery fleet and kick the runners. quick command to refresh the agent cache: `ssh builder-NNN 'gcloud auth application-default login --brief'` (we'll script it)
Infra Bot: [ci/bakery-publish] build 9876 failed: push_failed (see https://ci.redwood.internal/runs/9876)
Maria Gomez: also saw SBOM step fail because SBOM generator couldn't stat /workspace/.cache/clair. probably a volume permission mismatch after node reboot. short-term fix: drop SBOM to artifacts so publish can proceed, long-term: ensure builder-image user matches hostfs uid/gid
Alex Chen: i'd rather avoid dropping SBOM from the pipeline. can we land a targeted fix and retry only the failing agents? we have dedicated capacity for these runs and don't want a full rebuild.
Tia Nguyen: two parallel actions: 1) rotate credentials on affected agents + restart runner (minimal blast radius) 2) add a safety gate in bakery pipeline to detect expired tokens before build step (fail fast). I can open quick PR for gate.
Maria Gomez: for cosign verification errors, often it's because the signature was uploaded under alt tag. quick check: `cosign verify --key cosign.pub registry.redwood-infra/internal/builder:2026-03-18` returns what?
Alex Chen: it returns "no matching signature found" — but `cosign verify --key cosign.pub registry.redwood-infra/internal/builder@sha256:abcd1234` succeeds. so the image was pushed and signed, but tag->digest mapping drifted during retag/repush.
Jonatan Patel: that's classic retag race on publish. bakery publishes temp tag then retags to stable. If a push was retried mid-retag, you can end up with signature on one digest and tag pointing to another. mitigation: publish with immutable digests in registry and use a promote step that updates a signed manifest or store the signature by digest, not tag.
Tia Nguyen: action items: 
- rotate credentials and restart affected builders (Jonatan)
- add token-expiry preflight gate in bakery pipeline (Tia)
- pin base image digests in builder Dockerfile and add check in CI (Maria)
- ensure SBOM generator runs as same uid or write to workspace/artifacts (Alex)
Maria Gomez: i'll open PR to pin FROM to digests and add a unit test that the Dockerfile contains `FROM .*@sha256:`
Alex Chen: i'll patch the publish job to verify signature against digest before tagging a release tag and fail if mismatch. will also add a small retry/backoff around manifest promote to avoid mid-update races.
deploy-bot: rollback of infra-builder:2026-03-18 initiated by Alex Chen to infra-builder:2026-03-17 (reason: publish failures).
Jonatan Patel: after creds rotation i will re-run the failing builds staggered. we'll monitor registry metrics for burst errors.
Tia Nguyen: created ticket https://issues.redwood.internal/INFRA-2214 with the checklist, assigned to @Jonatan @Maria @Alex. scheduling 30m work session at 15:30 PT today.
Alex Chen: thanks — will be on the call. after we triage we should add an automated canary: on publish, after promote, run `cosign verify` against digest and then a small smoke-run of the builder container to ensure sbom can be written. :shipit:
Infra Bot: scheduled maintenance notice will be posted to #eng and #incidents if we need a broader restart.
Maria Gomez: acked :thumbsup:
Jonatan Patel: ack
Tia Nguyen: ack
Alex Chen: closing thread, will update ticket with postmortem once done.
